details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced a consistent inflow streak over nine days, from April 14 to April 24, accumulating approximately $2.12 billion. The largest single-day inflow during this period was recorded on April 17, with net inflows reaching $663.91 million. This sustained institutional demand signals strong underlying interest and capital allocation into Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Nine-Day Inflow Streak, Totaling $2.12 Billion

details: Bitcoin has experienced volatility amidst fluctuating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, briefly nearing $80,000 before pulling back. In a related development, the United States imposed sanctions on several Iran-linked crypto wallets, including addresses holding $344 million frozen by Tether, a move that impacts broader risk asset sentiment. Despite these tensions, Bitcoin has demonstrated resilience, trading around $77,743.7.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Fuel Bitcoin Volatility, US Sanctions Iran-Linked Wallets

details: On-chain analysis indicates a significant capital rotation within the Bitcoin market, suggesting sustained accumulation by large holders. Over the past 30 days, "sharks" (wallets holding 100-1,000 BTC) accumulated 37.92K BTC, while the 1K-10K BTC cohort added 9.57K BTC. This behavior, alongside declining exchange reserves, suggests investors are moving assets off exchanges for long-term holding, potentially absorbing selling pressure and setting the stage for future price appreciation. Bitcoin is currently trading around $77,353.
title: Bitcoin Whales Accumulate Amid Market Uncertainty

details: Regulatory bodies are increasing their focus on the crypto space, particularly concerning prediction markets and stablecoins. The CFTC is challenging New York over its crackdown on prediction markets, a stance supported by 38 Attorneys General in the case against Kalshi. Brazil has also implemented a ban on Kalshi and Polymarket, citing investor protection concerns. Concurrently, central banks globally are increasingly viewing stablecoins as a significant monetary threat, indicating a shift in the regulatory debate towards national monetary sovereignty.
title: Regulators Intensify Scrutiny on Prediction Markets and Stablecoins
